summary: Per-step token cost extraction for eval records has been 'fixed' at least 6 times (commits 1a7a9778, 157e969d, 1eec357b, ce317449, c6d7ae78, 4e5d7124) and still fails in practice: most boot eval records show $0 per step with token_source lenient_fallback, and populated ones show implausible counts (3.8M input tokens). David asked for boot cost comparison and the data could not answer it. Threshold exceeded.
proposed_fix: Stop patching. Root-cause first: read each prior fix commit, determine why each failed, then either implement a fix that passes a live end-to-end test (today's boot eval populated with plausible per-step costs) or declare the transcript-matching approach architecturally broken and propose the alternative design. Acceptance is measured data, not a merged change.

resolution.verdict: The transcript time-window matching design is architecturally unsound for per-step attribution AS IMPLEMENTED, because its window inputs (step frontmatter started-at/completed-at) are agent-authored and provably unreliable, and its record routing was by recency. The fix replaces independent per-step window queries with (a) strict-only matching (no fabrication fallback), (b) workflow-keyed record routing, and (c) a partition of the executing subagent's own transcript across the run's steps with a checkable sum integrity invariant, plus (d) capture of the harness's authoritative task-notification usage block.

why_each_prior_fix_failed.1a7a9778: Fixed real plumbing bugs (step-name key mismatch, status vocabulary) but validated against synthetic temp dirs with inline steps; never addressed recency record routing or stale agent-authored timestamps, so real subagent-executed boots kept failing.
why_each_prior_fix_failed.157e969d: Backfill assumed windowed slicing of the MAIN transcript maps to steps; subagent-run steps have no main-transcript turns, so it zero-filled or fell back; provenance labels documented the wrongness without fixing it.
why_each_prior_fix_failed.1eec357b: Recovered agent attribution/completion from subagent transcripts and explicitly flagged the loose record-matching fallback as 'not fixed'; the per-step window path was untouched.
why_each_prior_fix_failed.ce317449: Fixed sibling-spawn misattribution and the parent-closed rollup race for subagents[] totals only; per-step extraction and step-write routing were out of scope.
why_each_prior_fix_failed.c6d7ae78: Made session_id consistent across hooks, which actually WORSENED recency misrouting: all subagent stubs now share one session_id, so find_active_eval_record sees every concurrent stub.
why_each_prior_fix_failed.4e5d7124: Fixed chief-owned workflow detection and pricing-table gaps; token windowing logic untouched.

resolution.root_cause: Four compounding layers, proven from the 2026-10-21 live run (session 345c604d, /tmp/ies-hook-errors.log): (1) post-tool-use.py routed step writes to the most-recent in-progress record for the session, so Knox's plaud-ingest steps landed on the boot executor's stub (eval-20261021T151415-QZP2GE) and corrupted its workflow stamp to 'plaud-ingest'; (2) eval-agent-stop.py resolved the workflow from that corrupted stamp and ran plaud-ingest step-complete against the BOOT EXECUTOR's transcript; (3) step frontmatter timestamps are agent-authored fiction — plaud steps 02-06 still carried 2026-10-09 windows, boot steps 06-08 carry 15:47-15:50 windows for a subagent that ended 15:41:15, and boot step-01.2's started-at was ~45s late so its window caught only zero-usage thinking turns; (4) usage_between's lenient_fallback converted every window miss into a whole-transcript sum, stamping 1,654,697 tokens ($0.6313) onto EACH of six stale steps. Amplifiers: an f-string crash on cost_usd=None discarded successful extractions (6x at 10:37 for morning-briefing), inline extraction read the main transcript for subagent-written steps (concurrent-turn noise labeled 'windowed'), and the executor's own record lost its final write (completed/totals null, later flat $0.09 estimate over a real $0.63 run).
fix_applied: systems/eval-harness/token_usage.py: new partition_usage_by_steps (attributes every billable turn of one agent's transcript to exactly one step by started-at ordering; stale steps excluded; sum == whole-run invariant), extract_task_notifications/latest_task_usage (parse <task-notification> usage blocks from the main transcript), turns_with_usage count, deepseek-v4p1-flash-1017 pricing alias
.claude/hooks/step-complete.py: lenient fallback retired (strict window only, honest nulls), fixed f-string crash that discarded extracted tokens when cost was None, records turns_with_usage

.claude/hooks/eval-agent-stop.py: crash-safe ordering (core completion fields persisted BEFORE step-hook fan-out), task-notification fallback for whole-run totals (harness_tokens), parent-record partition backfill of per-step tokens (token_source windowed-partition, executed_by_agent_id), stale-step guard (skip steps completed before this run started), rollup carries harness_tokens/token_source
.claude/hooks/post-tool-use.py: step writes route by the step's own workflow (name/workflow match), never by recency; completed records within 6h grace accept late step writes; no match = honest skip
.claude/hooks/eval-turn-stop.py: double-count guard (partition-filled steps excluded from step sums when their subagent's rollup carries tokens), harness_tokens_total surfaced
systems/eval-harness/schema.md: token_source values, turns_with_usage, executed_by_agent_id, harness_tokens documented; subagent capture path rewritten
.claude/hooks/tests/test_step_token_capture.py: inline-extraction test updated to the workflow-routing contract; new regression tests for cross-workflow routing refusal and closed-record grace window

acceptance_test.method: Repaired with the new code paths against today's real data (executor transcript agent-a548027b586ba0f14.jsonl, main transcript task-notifications); backups at /tmp/QNQLC5.bak.json and /tmp/QZP2GE.bak.json

known_residual_risks: post-tool-use.py inline extraction still reads the main transcript for subagent-written steps (hook payload carries no agent identity), so a concurrent main-session turn can be labeled 'windowed' on a subagent step; partition backfill only fills null tokens and will not overwrite such values

step frontmatter timestamps remain agent-authored; the partition makes the damage transparent (integrity-checked) but per-step granularity for steps with fictional windows is honestly zero, not estimated

SubagentStop does not reliably fire/find stubs for every background agent (5 'No eval record found' events today); the task-notification path in eval-turn-stop sweeps are the fallback but were only wired into eval-agent-stop in this pass
